/docs.title: Guides
/docs.description: Learn ItsyWeb with a hands-on Getting Started tutorial and focused guides to templates, styling, editing, deployment, and more.

/docs/installation.title: Installation and updates
/docs/installation.description: Install a supported CLI, update an existing installation, and check version requirements.

/docs/development.title: Local development
/docs/development.description: Create projects, use live reload, and test from another device on your network.

/docs/templates.title: Pages, layouts and data
/docs/templates.description: Map files to URLs, share markup with layouts and partials, and use JSON data.

/docs/styling.title: CSS and icons
/docs/styling.description: Customize theme tokens, write CSS, and use the built-in icon syntax.

/docs/deployment.title: Server setup and deployment
/docs/deployment.description: Set up an Ubuntu host and publish committed source with automatic HTTPS.

/docs/redirects.title: Migration redirects
/docs/redirects.description: Map old paths directly to their replacements with exact 301 redirects.

/docs/seo.title: Search engines and SEO
/docs/seo.description: Configure sitemaps, canonical URLs, Search Console, and staging indexing policy.

/docs/recovery.title: Backups and recovery
/docs/recovery.description: Back up a site, recover code or content, and understand what each operation preserves.

/docs/editing.title: On-page editing
/docs/editing.description: Make selected content editable, enable admin access, and sync live changes.

/docs/media.title: Photos, videos and collections
/docs/media.description: Add editable media and lists that admins can manage on the page.

/docs/email.title: Email and contact forms
/docs/email.description: Preview email locally, configure delivery, and add the bundled Contact form.

/docs/blog.title: Blog
/docs/blog.description: Enable a blog, customize its templates, and create and publish posts.

/docs/apps.title: Managed apps
/docs/apps.description: Understand app mounts, build a local executable, and work with app-owned sessions.

/docs/agents.title: Working with coding agents
/docs/agents.description: Use the bundled site, import, Blog, and Contact instructions with a coding agent.

/docs/release-notes.title: Release notes
/docs/release-notes.description: Read the changes and upgrade requirements for each published release.

/docs/support.title: About ItsyWeb and support
/docs/support.description: Understand where ItsyWeb fits, its current limits, and how to report a problem.

/docs/getting-started.title: Getting Started
/docs/getting-started.description: Build your first ItsyWeb site, step by step: two HTML pages, shared navigation, a layout, a partial, and a little CSS.
